attempts.summary: Built a fresh three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd previously), loaded five application keys under /app/, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via node1 while node1+node2 preserved quorum, added a new member for node3, and started etcd there with initial-cluster-state=existing so it joined and fully synced. Verified all three members healthy, all raft indices matched, and all five application keys present on the rebuilt node3. Then executed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines on all nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never breaking quorum), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and re-verified cluster health, membership, and key data after each restart.
